name: Ezetimibe
description: A selective inhibitor of intestinal cholesterol absorption at the NPC1L1 transporter, approved for hyperlipidaemia alone or with a statin.

systems.note: LDL cholesterol reduction and cardiovascular risk reduction; the labelled indication.
Transaminase elevation is labelled, particularly in combination with a statin.

monitors.why: Sums every atherogenic particle and is computable from a standard panel.
Labelled transaminase elevation, higher in statin combination.
